description: Phase 1 feasibility prototype - proves axis.labelOverlap:'greedy' thins Category axis ticks without overlap as category count grows and width shrinks. Tested in Vega-Lite Editor 2026-09-23 with 24 synthetic categories at width 350: only every ~3rd label (Jan-24, May-24, Aug-24, Nov-24, Feb-25, May-25, Aug-25, Nov-25) was shown, cleanly spaced, no overlap. Real Power BI/Deneb resize behavior still needs Phase 2 prototype confirmation per PROJECT_PLAN.md Phase 1 item 4(b).
